name: google-play-api
what_it_holds: Turns google-play-scraper into a RESTful API server (MIT, 389 stars, updated 5 Sep 2026) -- same underlying fields (install buckets, rating, category rank), just exposed over HTTP instead of as a library import.
why_useful: Convenience wrapper only; no new fields versus the base google-play-scraper. Noted for completeness since it appeared prominently in results, but adds nothing the base library doesn't already give us.
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series
why_all: Convenience wrapper only; no new fields versus the base google-play-scraper. Noted for completeness since it appeared prominently in results, but adds nothing the base library doesn't already give us.

name: cmmntlnd
what_it_holds: Real-time monitor for App Store & Google Play reviews that forwards new reviews to Slack; a live alerting tool rather than a historical archive.
why_useful: Could be adapted to log every new Airbnb app review (with timestamp/rating) going forward into a running review-count/sentiment time series, addressing gap 14's review-scraper angle, but builds no history retroactively.
